title: 3PL Follow-on Effort RFI
description: GSA Federal Acquisition Service sources-sought request for a third-party logistics (3PL) provider for export operations supporting overseas customers: receiving inbound transatlantic and transpacific ocean shipments, inspection and preparation, transshipment, consolidation, and onward movement through small-package carriers, USPS and the Defense Transportation System, plus discrepancy reporting. No set-aside used.
